native_profile_evidence.qualification: These are actual native constructor/table facts. No inspected caller directly reads a template type tag or checks its current vtable before the five calls. alias_and_index_limits: Store classification is based on native pointer provenance: none uses the colour source pointer as its store base. It is not a proof against malformed GUI/material pointers aliasing arbitrary memory.
005D0AF2 uses an unchecked index in the inspected slice. A value outside an intended colour range can read other GlobalConfig words; no index bound or safe range is inferred.
Copying raw DWORD values to GUI colour storage is not retention/publication of the source pointer or ownership of any value those DWORDs happen to encode.
